cs.t: I have a arturia keystep and keystep pro, and love them. They are great for composing, the built in sequencer is easy to use and they have midi and cv outs which work nicely for a dawless setup. I am seeing more and more of my favorite artists using them, so i guess i'm not the only one who loves them. The keystep fits into my small backpack and I live in a mountain area so in 15 minutes i'm in the forest, I connect it to my phone and come up with melodic lines. Although i'm not much of a musician it's great for relaxing after a busy day
